tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background, the warm cream (light) or deep plum (dark). Body text `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: sidebar, table rails, segmented-control tracks, skeleton base. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, drawers, popovers and the tab bar sitting on `surface-100`. `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icon colour (warm cocoa, never black) on `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-raised`, the `blob-*` fills and `primary-soft`. Also the sticker outline on chart marks.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (labels, captions, helper copy) on `surface-100`, `surface-200` and `surface-raised`. Not for use on `blob-*` fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dashed list dividers. Never the only edge of a control (use `outline`).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and drop zones; 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one friendly accent: primary buttons, the Scan button, the current month's bar. Text on it is `on-primary`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of `primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `primary-hover` (white in light, dark cocoa in dark so contrast holds).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, active tab icon pill, soft highlights. `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on all surfaces and on `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: blob-peach
tokens.usage: Organic background blobs, inactive chart bars, merchant bars. `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: blob-butter
tokens.usage: Hero KPI card, viewfinder corner guides, sparkles. Use `ink` (not `ink-muted`) for text on it.

tokens.name: blob-sage
tokens.usage: Background blobs and the empty-state ground.

tokens.name: blob-lavender
tokens.usage: Background blobs and the secondary decorative accent.

tokens.name: blob-sky
tokens.usage: Background blobs and informational ground.

tokens.name: win-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a positive 'win' chip (spent less, done reading). Pair with `win-ink`.

tokens.name: win-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `win-bg`. Always with a word or arrow, never colour alone.

tokens.name: rise-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a gentle 'went up / take a peek' chip, in warm amber, never alarming red. Pair with `rise-ink`.

tokens.name: rise-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `rise-bg`; also the low-confidence highlight on a line item.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the 'reading' status pill and tips. Pair with `info-ink`.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `info-bg`.

tokens.name: oops-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the soft 'oops, try again' state for failed reads. Pair with `oops-ink`.

tokens.name: oops-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `oops-bg`.

tokens.name: cat-groceries
tokens.usage: Category fill for Groceries (green, mid lightness). Label it with `on-cat`; always ship with the emoji and name.

tokens.name: cat-kids
tokens.usage: Category fill for Kids (amber, the lightest).

tokens.name: cat-eating
tokens.usage: Category fill for Eating out (coral, the darkest warm).

tokens.name: cat-home
tokens.usage: Category fill for Home (sky blue).

tokens.name: cat-school
tokens.usage: Category fill for School (lavender).

tokens.name: cat-other
tokens.usage: Category fill for Everything else (tan).

tokens.name: on-cat
tokens.usage: Label colour on every `cat-*` fill, in both themes (7:1 or better). Also the badge border.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind the receipt drawer and dialogs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Axis labels, table headers, tab labels. Never smaller than 12px.

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Amounts in tables and lists. Always tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop main padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target; empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Skeleton bars, small inputs, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner tiles, table rows, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Device frames, viewfinder, drawers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, chips, inputs, the Scan button.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, drawers, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Primary button 'sticker' edge; it presses down on :active.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Hover bounce, drawer slide.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Success pop, chart bars growing in.

tokens.name: ease-bounce
tokens.usage: Gentle overshoot for hover bounce and success pop.

tokens.name: ease-soft
tokens.usage: Everything else.
